Liam (AE): Heads-up 1. Mercury is evaluating a swap from VeloxAI. They want a drop-in POC: same request/response shapes, webhook callbacks, and identical auth headers. They want 4-week trial ~2M tokens. Can SEs confirm feasibility?

Noor (Sales Eng): We can map headers and body fields at the edge. Need to know which Velox endpoints they use (stream vs non-stream, embeddings vs chat). Ask Mercury to share a sample of 50 live requests.

Aisha (CS): Security asks: SOC2 + customer-managed KMS. Also they want audit logs retained 90 days and an IP allowlist for inbound webhooks.

Jasper (Platform): Technical notes: we don't promise byte-for-byte identical completions. Tokenizer/model mismatch may shift outputs. Approach: 1) compatibility adapter that rewrites paths and headers 2) canonicalize prompts (normalize whitespace/quotes) 3) run 200 request parity checks. Example nginx mapping snippet: ```# map velox Authorization -> our X-API-Key
proxy_set_header X-Api-Key $http_authorization;
proxy_pass_request_body on;
proxy_set_header Content-Type $http_content_type;```

Jasper (Platform): For streaming, we support chunked transfer and SSE. If Velox uses a custom keepalive, we should mirror that at the adapter to reduce client-side changes.

Noor (Sales Eng): Procurement asked if we can do a flat POC fee instead of token billing. They offered to pre-pay a capped amount. Finance will want to know what Dedicated vs Hosted delta is. I'll draft two options: hosted timeboxed credits vs dedicated with base fee + reduced per-token.

Liam (AE): They also want webhooks to come from static IPs for their firewall. Jasper 1, can we supply egress IP ranges or static NAT for dedicated?

Jasper (Platform): Yes for Dedicated we can provide static egress IPs. For Hosted we'd provide a small CIDR pool but not guaranteed single IP. For Private deployment they can bring their own NAT or we can coordinate.

Aisha (CS): Legal wants to know if our standard DPA + SOC2 report is enough or whether they'd require additional attestation. legal-bot, any precedent?

legal-bot: Mercury requested enhanced controls for key custody in 2 prior deals. We normally accept customer-managed KMS in Private or Dedicated, and SOC2 + DPA suffice for Hosted if they don't need BYOK.

Noor (Sales Eng): Eval rubric proposal: 1) API contract parity (100 random samples) 2) streaming behavior matches 3) P95 latency delta < 100ms vs Velox baseline 4) embedding cosine delta within 0.02 on test set 5) token delta < 6%

Jasper (Platform): Suggest adding canary rollout plan: route 5% traffic for first day, 25% next, monitor errors/quality. If drift > threshold, auto-fallback to Velox. Config example: ```canary:
  steps: [5,25,100]
  monitor: error_rate < 0.5% and avg_latency < 500ms
  fallback: velox-proxy
```

Liam (AE): Mercury's security lead will want the KMS integration steps and key rotation policy. Jasper, can you produce a short KMS runbook and network diagram by EOD tomorrow?

Jasper (Platform): Yes. I'll post CIDRs and a one-page KMS flow showing encrypt/decrypt calls and rotation times. Also note: Velox pads system messages differently; our adapter will strip padding and normalize role fields to reduce output drift.

Aisha (CS): I'll collect the 50 sample requests and send them to Noor + Jasper. Also will start filling their security questionnaire and flag items needing eng/legal input.

Noor (Sales Eng): Next steps: 1) Liam to get sample requests 2) Jasper to deliver IP list + KMS runbook 3) I'll send 2 pricing options (timeboxed credit & dedicated discounted rate) 4) Aisha will share security questionnaire draft. Target: internal sign-off in 48 hours. :thumbsup:

Liam (AE): Thanks everyone. cc @Mercury procurement when ready. :rocket:
